name: Grottle
tagline: A clearer fuel gauge for your weekly Grok Bot usage
description: Tell it your usage percentage and where the weekly window resets, and it hands back a read-out that is easier to judge at a glance than the raw number. Where the reset moment can be pinned down, the estimate of what is left becomes more useful for planning the rest of the week.
author: BCornTexas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
